sentences.text: The petitioner was on interim bail to appear for her examination which was scheduled to be held from 3rd March, 2023.
The petitioner's examination will over on 1st of April, 2023.
It is submitted at the Bar that the Case Diary is received with the Post Mortem Report along with the FSL Report.
The Post Mortem Report depicts that the deceased died as a result of suicide.
The opinion of death was kept pending till report of Forensic test.
The Lab Test Report depicts that no poison was detected on examination of the viscera.
The Post Mortem Report as well as the Inquest Report depicts of a non-continuous ligature mark on the neck of the deceased.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the deceased committed suicide.
The petitioner has prayed that interim order dated 01.03.2023 be made absolute.

As the petitioner is a juvenile, the petitioner is directed to appear before the Juvenile Justice Board within 15 (fifteen) days and apply for bail which may be considered according to the decision of the Board.
